response.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points > 6.0 GROUP BY r.name

assumptions.assumption: Entries with NULL points are excluded by the points > 6.0 filter. AVG ignores NULL wins. Because the groups only contain rows that passed the filter, no group can be empty, so the 'missing if none' case never arises.
